content.short: Arcade2Earn is a GameFi platform that rewards members with tokens from play-to-earn metaverse games.
content.description: Arcade2Earn is a GameFi platform that offers the opportunity for meaningful rewards from play-to-earn games in the metaverse, without requiring direct gameplay or ownership of in-game NFTs. It distributes rewards to members through mission pools that leverage members' ownership of games and in-game NFTs, along with their strategic connections to guilds, gamers, contributors, and game developers. These mission pools connect diverse game ecosystems and communities to enable participation in the rewards program based on ownership and networks rather than active gameplay.
